DICT-IMPORT.summary: Installs a preshared ZSTD dictionary as the new active dict.
DICT-IMPORT.complexity: O(N) where N is the dictionary size in bytes (digesting CDict/DDict).

arguments.name: dictionary-bytes-base64
arguments.summary: Base64-encoded raw dictionary bytes (as produced by ZDICT_trainFromBuffer or by COMPRESSION DICT-EXPORT).

reply_schema.description: Integer dict ID assigned by the registry on success; -ERR on malformed base64, invalid dictionary bytes, or registry full.
